description: Decode a VIN and return a vehicle report: specs, recalls (with manufacturer build-date ranges), a complaint summary with the most recent complaints, safety ratings, fuel economy, EPA test-vehicle data, parts content and origin (MY2020+), historical production and theft (MY1998-2012), and photo URLs. decode_checks checks the official decode field by field (drive, engine, electrification, transmission, speeds, seats, GVWR) against the manufacturer's description of this VIN, NHTSA test vehicles with the same VIN pattern and EPA's configurations: confirmed, corrected, doubtful or filled, with vPIC's original value kept.

transmission.description: Transmission, when the owner knows it and the VIN does not say. Applies to fuel economy only when EPA lists the model with both; without it an automatic is assumed and marked (fuel_economy.assumed, alternatives).

name: decode_vin
